biggest_catch: You only earn by actively reporting shopping every week — points don't accrue passively — and acceptance is by invitation/demographic quotas, so many applicants are waitlisted or never accepted.
catches: Must submit weekly shopping-trip reports (scan barcodes, report online purchases) — no passive earning.
Enrollment is quota-based: household demographics and zip code determine acceptance; not open to everyone.
Points accumulate slowly; rewards are gift cards and merchandise, not direct cash to bank.
Also runs sweepstakes (Pick 'N Win, quarterly $20,000 Grand Prix) — entries are not guaranteed money.

steps: Fill out the join form at join.ncponline.com and complete the qualification survey.
If accepted by demographic quota, download the NCPMobile app.
Scan barcodes of your purchases and report online shopping every week.
Earn reward points for each submitted shopping trip.
Redeem points in the app's Reward Redemption Center for digital gift cards (Amazon, Visa, PayPal, Groupon), merchandise, or sweepstakes entries.
timing: Points awarded weekly for submitted reports; rewards arrive by email as digital redemption codes.
